title: Unique Midnight Jamaican Sardine Hash
description: A citrusy and gooey Jamaican dish featuring sardines, perfect for midnight cravings, made with Whole30-friendly ingredients and a spherification twist.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the diced scotch bonnet pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped sardines, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Squeeze the lime juice over the top of the mixture and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, mix the sodium alginate and water to create a spherification bath.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the sardine mixture into the spherification bath and let sit for 2-3 minutes to form spheres.
Remove the spheres from the bath with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess liquid.
Serve the sardine spheres hot, garnished with additional lime juice and scotch bonnet pepper if desired.
